title: Phonidex
summary: A turntable simulator that puts a DJ’s deck on an iPhone — designed and built in SwiftUI.
intro: A pocket turntable: load a track from your phone and handle it the way you would on a deck — scratch the platter, set cue points and ride the pitch fader.

images.alt: Phonidex deck screen with the platter, cue and play buttons and pitch fader
